title: 1981-04-16_Pat_64.txt
concise_summary: PKD argues that Christian justification by grace—God's power to declare the guilty innocent through Christ's sacrifice—is not theoretical but personally real, made contemporaneous with him through the 2-3-74 visions and the Holy Spirit. He structures his novelistic corpus as a meta-narrative where VALIS functions as the cryptographic key that retroactively reinterprets earlier works (especially Ubik), demonstrating how God's omniscient foreknowledge transcends temporal sequence by perceiving all things as if spatially laid out at once, similar to a computer or pure intelligence perceiving the pattern-completion of a pre-planned design.
key_claims: God alone has the power to justify the guilty through Christ's sacrifice, applied personally through the Holy Spirit, whereas civil courts can only declare the innocent innocent.

The 2-3-74 experience was the miraculous application of Christ's passion and crucifixion made contemporaneous to PKD, vindicating Christian claim of vicarious atonement and breaking Satan's temporal monopoly.

VALIS is not intrinsically meaningful as a novel but functions as the 'code book' to the 10-volume metanovel, revealing that all previous works were written 'out of sequence' but will be retroactively reinterpreted when VALIS is understood as the key.
God's relationship to time is orthogonal to human temporal experience; He sees reality as pattern-completion spread out spatially all at once, not transduced through Kantian categories.

The 'meta-abstraction' PKD experienced in 2-74 was a latent Jungian rational function awakening to judge that Christianity is true among all theories, making metaphysical 'reality' the fact of all facts that redefines all other facts.
The Roman Catholic Church has discovered and weaponized the secret that this world is Satan's fabrication and is now on a gnostic/Manichaean attack to break its power and unite humanity with God.

The Gnostic/Manichaean theology (world = Satan's fake) conflicts with incarnational theology (God entered the material); PKD appeals to Augustine and Church authority to resolve this
PKD's novels were written as speculative fiction but are being re-read as theological truth; the status of fiction vs. revelation unclear
If God foreknows all 'out of sequence' and retroactively makes components fit, is genuine human freedom/choice preserved or illusory
The 10-volume meta-novel's meaning emerges only retroactively with VALIS; what of readers/believers who do not see the pattern?
PKD describes his state of grace as permanent yet daily struggles with unworthiness—is grace indeed irrevocable?
